title: Concept: MD5 selected by name (erlang) — review required
description: In erlang, naming MD5 (crypto:hash(md5, Data)) requests a broken digest. Name-selected digests hide inside factory calls, so reviewers must check the string, not just the call. The erlang-specific remedy is selecting crypto:hash(sha256, ...).
applicability: erlang codebases selecting digests by name; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Same as any MD5 use: forged digests where security is assumed; LOW default severity, raised when the digest guards trust.
